meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你在 NanoClaw 分叉里的改动写成一份迁移指南；升级上游时先取干净的上游代码，再按指南重放改动，不再用 git 合并。
howto.when: 当你想把 NanoClaw 分叉升级到上游，或想把自定义改动整理成迁移指南时触发。已有迁移指南时，Claude 会先问你是直接升级还是更新指南。

say.text: 帮我升级 NanoClaw 到上游，保留我的改动
say.note: 会先提取改动，再按指南重放

say.text: 把这次分叉的改动整理成迁移指南
say.note: 进入提取阶段，生成指南

say.text: 迁移指南已存在，直接按它升级
say.note: 跳过提取，直接进入升级阶段

howto.what_en: With this skill installed, Claude turns your custom changes in a NanoClaw fork into a replayable migration guide; when upgrading upstream, it takes a clean copy and reapplies those changes from the guide instead of running git merge.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to upgrade a customized NanoClaw fork to upstream or to export customizations. If a guide exists, Claude offers to skip straight to upgrade.

say_en.text: Upgrade this NanoClaw fork to upstream, keeping my changes
Turn this fork's customizations into a migration guide
A migration guide already exists — use it to upgrade
